name: Emitter-follower operating conditions
source:
// Emitter-follower condition study. Generic builtin BJT, not a rated hardware design.
param supply: V = 5V
param load: Ohm = 1kOhm
param bias: V = 3.3V
net GND
net VCC
net IN
net OUT
source VS {supply}
source VIN sine_ac({bias},100mV,1kHz,1V)
transistor Q1 npn 2N3904
resistor RL {load}
connect VS.plus, Q1.c to VCC
connect VIN.plus, Q1.b to IN
connect Q1.e, RL.p1 to OUT
connect VS.minus, VIN.minus, RL.p2 to GND
simulate ac dec 40 10Hz 100kHz
simulate tran 2us 3ms
assert gain_at(V(OUT),V(IN),1kHz) > 0.9
assert peak(V(OUT)) > 2V
assert peak(V(OUT)) < 3.3V
assert dissipation(Q1,1ms,3ms) < 40mW
